    The dual of a string module (equation (3.d)) #

    Monomial data on B give monomial data on Bᵐᵒᵖ over the opposite quiver (MonomialData.op). For a string w, the word w^D with the same letters and reversed directions is a string over the opposite data (Word.dualWord, Word.isString_dual), and the k-dual of M(w), a module over Bᵐᵒᵖ, is isomorphic to M(w^D) (Word.dualEquiv).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.MonomialData.op_pval_ne {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (D : MonomialData k B) {y : D.Q.V} {l : List D.Q.A} (h : D.toPathData.opD.pval y l ≠ 0) :
    D.pval (D.Q.op.pend y l) l.reverse ≠ 0 ∧ D.toPathData.opD.pval y l = MulOpposite.op (D.pval (D.Q.op.pend y l) l.reverse)
    source
